title: RSS Feed Reader - Atom, Articles, Dates & New Items
description: Example: {"feedUrls": ["https://blog.python.org/feeds/posts/default?alt=rss"], "maxResults": 3}. Successful source parsing is billed, including zero-match checks; set maxTotalChargeUsd as an Apify run option.

feedUrls.title: Feed URLs
feedUrls.description: Pass 1–50 public feed URLs, e.g. ['https://blog.python.org/feeds/posts/default?alt=rss']. Exact source URLs only; no website discovery. XML must be at most 8 MB decompressed. Successfully parsed sources are billed even when filters leave zero rows.

maxResults.title: Maximum output rows
maxResults.description: 1000 for URLs or 100 for entries by default. Caps delivered rows across all sources after filters. Reaching this cap stops further source requests.

sinceDate.title: Earliest date
sinceDate.description: Empty (default) keeps every date. Example: "2026-10-01" or "2026-10-01T12:00:00Z". Inclusive UTC cutoff on lastmod or publication date (updated date when publication is absent). Rows with missing or invalid dates are excluded when set. Source parsing is still billed.

titleKeywords.title: Title keywords
titleKeywords.description: [] (default) keeps all titles. Example: ["Python", "release"] keeps titles containing either literal phrase, case insensitive. Filters apply before row caps; each successfully parsed feed is still billed.

maxItemsPerFeed.title: Maximum entries per feed
maxItemsPerFeed.description: 100 (default). Example: 10 keeps at most ten matching entries from each feed, in publisher order. Filters and excluded IDs are applied first. The global maxResults cap may stop earlier. No per-entry fee.

excludeIds.title: Previously returned IDs
excludeIds.description: [] (default) keeps all unseen rows within this run. Pass id values from an earlier dataset, e.g. ["previous-id"], to omit them. No state is remembered automatically. Source parsing remains billed even when every row is excluded.
